verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud offers an agent runtime and an answer engine, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only documents Orama's own MCP server, which exposes project data to assistants like ChatGPT and Cursor. That is the server role and does not show Orama acting as an MCP client that plugs in other servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
